body.statement: In the balanced two-arm binary finite-population minimax problem, permutation symmetrization reduces the exact labelled observation law to the shifted-binomial experiment.

source.verbatim_statement: By an invariance argument, it suffices to keep track of the parameters p,q,r and to use estimators which are functions of ∑ᵢSᵢ. Therefore, it suffices to study the minimax risk of the even simpler model where we observe data X∼p+Bin(r,1/2), with estimand (p−q)/n. Theorem 2.1. r_n*=ρ_n*=inf_f sup_{I_n} E(f(p+Bin(r,1/2))−(p−q)/n)².
